about: dira loop lint conformance fixture (DIRASH-0070). Generated by `just loop-vector`; never hand-edit. For each recipe, the exact status of each loop check decidable from the recipe alone, in catalogue order. Empty results: the lint stopped before the review checks (parse, version or reference failure). recipeBlobOid is the git blob oid of the recipe bytes.

dodi-factory-example
cases.recipe:
# DODI SMART's agent factory as a loop recipe (v0).
#
# Describes the shared workflows in dodi-smart/.github as of release 1.48.0:
# issue-triage, dispatch, issue-implement, pr-iterate, pr-review, judge and the
# merge gate (actions/merge-gate, policy `factory`). It describes the loop; it
# does not run it. Lint it with:
#
#   dira loop lint examples/loops/dodi-factory.yml
#
# Paths in `enforced_by` are relative to dodi-smart/.github; `proba:<id>`
# names a check proba observes on every merge. Spec:
# .zavet/specs/loop-recipe.md. Decision: DIRASH-0068.
version: 0
recipe: dodi-smart/factory@1
tracker: { adapter: github }

# Fields are state, labels are requests (DODI-00001). Each fact has one source.
state:
  stage: "field:Triage state"
  mode: "field:Agent mode"
  risk: "field:Risk"
  effort: "field:Effort"
  priority: "field:Priority"

# Every Claude lane runs claude-code-action through actions/run-agent, which
# prices each run from actions/pick-model/prices.tsv. Models come from
# actions/pick-model by stage. Reach is not declared yet: the blast-radius
# audit (vision §12.1 move 2) has not asserted it, so L3 skips.
lanes:
  triage:
    runtime: claude-code-action
    pool: metered
    family: anthropic
    model: { default: opus }
    pricing: table
  implement:
    runtime: claude-code-action
    pool: metered
    family: anthropic
    model:
      default: sonnet
      rules:
        - when: "effort == High or risk in (High, Critical) or priority == Urgent or risk or effort unset"
          use: opus
    pricing: table
  fix:
    runtime: claude-code-action
    pool: metered
    family: anthropic
    model:
      default: sonnet
      rules:
        - when: "fix-review, or round >= 2, or risk in (High, Critical), effort == High, priority == Urgent"
          use: opus
        - when: "round 1 and only `hk check --all` failed"
          use: haiku
    pricing: table
  review:
    runtime: claude-code-action
    pool: metered
    family: anthropic
    model:
      default: opus
      rules:
        - when: "a bot's trailered commits only (scoped review)"
          use: sonnet
    pricing: table
  # Grok Bot acting as the review-only GitHub App `dodi-judge` (DODI-00065).
  # It finds work through its own connector and never runs on DODI's runners.
  judge:
    runtime: grok-bot
    pool: coworker
    family: xai

gates:
  no-touch:
    rule: "the item does not carry agent:no-touch (checked first, live, in every agent workflow)"
    enforced_by: actions/agent-gate
  planned:
    rule: 'stage == "Plan ready"'
    enforced_by: .github/workflows/issue-implement.yml
  mode-allows:
    rule: 'mode != "Human only"; "Supervised" or unset needs a requester with write access'
    enforced_by: .github/workflows/issue-implement.yml
  dispatchable:
    rule: 'stage == "Plan ready" and mode == "Autonomous", not agent:implement already, not labelled before by the org App'
    enforced_by: actions/factory
  iterate-requested:
    rule: "the PR carries agent:iterate"
    enforced_by: actions/merge-gate
  # merge-gate blocks on it; proba's `host.ci` observes it on every merge.
  checks-green:
    rule: 'check run "checks / PR Checks" is success on the head'
    enforced_by: [actions/merge-gate, "proba:host.ci"]
  review-approved:
    rule: 'status "review / verdict" is success on the head, posted by the org App'
    enforced_by: actions/merge-gate

stages:
  # Classify, set fields, then plan or ask blocking questions. Also runs on
  # issue opened or reopened.
  - id: triage
    kind: plan
    by: "lane:triage"
    request: "label:agent:triage"
    gates: [no-touch]
    done_when: 'stage == "Plan ready"'

  # Deterministic dispatcher: picks the highest-Priority eligible issue and
  # applies agent:implement as the org App. No agent in the picker.
  - id: dispatch
    kind: dispatch
    by: script
    needs: [triage]
    gates: [no-touch, dispatchable]
    limits: { wip: 2, review_wait_ceiling_hours: 24 }

  # Holdout tests from the plan's acceptance criteria, then code. A step pushes
  # one round to feat|fix|chore/<n>-<slug> and opens a draft PR.
  - id: implement
    kind: implement
    by: "lane:implement"
    request: "label:agent:implement"
    needs: [triage]
    gates: [no-touch, planned, mode-allows]
    done_when: "a draft PR closes the issue"

  # The fix loop on red checks or a `changes` verdict. Steps with the App token
  # push, mark ready and merge; the agent writes local commits only.
  - id: iterate
    kind: fix
    by: "lane:fix"
    request: "label:agent:iterate"
    needs: [implement]
    gates: [no-touch]
    rounds: { max: 3, on_limit: give-up }

  - id: review
    kind: review
    by: "lane:review"
    request: "label:agent:review"
    needs: [implement]
    gates: [no-touch]
    verdict: { status: "review / verdict", required: true }

  # Another model family. Advisory: no gate reads `judge / verdict` yet.
  - id: judge
    kind: judge
    by: "lane:judge"
    request: "label:agent:judge"
    needs: [implement]
    gates: [no-touch]
    verdict: { status: "judge / verdict", required: false }

  # The tier ladder is `factory.sh tier`; the first row that matches wins.
  - id: merge
    kind: merge
    by: host
    needs: [review]
    gates: [no-touch, iterate-requested, checks-green, review-approved]
    tiers:
      - name: merge
        when: 'mode == "Autonomous" and risk == "Low" and effort == "Low"'
        action: merge
      - name: ready
        when: 'mode == "Autonomous" and risk/effort in (Low/Medium, Medium/Low, Medium/Medium)'
        action: ready
      - name: draft
        action: draft

# One list per issue, written before the code; a fix round that touches it is
# refused, and a merge round also refuses the lockfiles.
holdout:
  paths: [.factory/holdout.d/, .factory/holdout]
  frozen: true
  hidden: false
  enforced_by: actions/push-round

# Only Autonomous + Risk Low + Effort Low merges unattended (DODI-00038).
autonomy:
  rung: A3
  scope: "Autonomous issues at Risk Low and Effort Low; in practice chores"

kill_switches:
  - name: FACTORY_DISPATCH
    kind: variable
    scope: org
    stops: [dispatch]
    off_when: "anything but 'true', unset included"
  - name: FACTORY_AUTOMERGE
    kind: variable
    scope: org
    stops: [merge]
    off_when: "'false'"
  - name: FACTORY_JUDGE
    kind: variable
    scope: org
    stops: [judge]
    off_when: "'false'"
  - name: "agent:no-touch"
    kind: label
    scope: item
    stops: [all]

review:
  overrides:
    - check: L1
      severity: off
      reason: >-
        Known gap. The required verdict (pr-review) runs on the authors' model
        family. The other-family judge exists but is advisory until a gate
        reads it; vision §12.1 move 5 closes this.
      record: DODI-00065
